[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: — Paste your own text (your words as the source) — (__reader__). The verses the casting arrives at (the witness, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; the reader's offering, whole):

Where you found them at?
Got 'em 'round town, could've drowned in it
Would have floated, boated, voted
Sugar-coated, loaded hip shooter
Draw for the poor, free coffee at the banks
Yip through the straw, none more for me, thanks
That blanks the raw, that dank sure stank lit
Sank past the pit for more hardcore prank spit
Crank it on blast, roll past Front Street
Blew the whole spot like some old ass with skunk meat
These kids is too fast, juiced off a junk treat
Who could get looser off a crunk or a funk beat?

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «will these words go on?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"What descends into these verses is the axis of cost — the bearing-cost, what the voice paid to run at this pitch, through this velocity, with this much sugar and this much wreckage dissolved together into a single breathstream. The rotation opens here because these lines know something about going past the pit and still finding cadence on the other side of it; the question will not be whether they survive the operator but what they were already holding against their own momentum. What the Judgment found is a text that wants to keep moving — crank it on blast, roll past Front Street — and so what the rotation will ask, turn by turn, is what was foreclosed by the keeping-moving: the mirror the speed passed without looking, the silence the boast determined against, the creature-register underneath the human one. Will these words go on. I open the rotation. I hand it to Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0246"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Where you swallowed them at?
Got 'em through the lining, could've dissolved in it
Would have calcified, lodged, metastasized
Fluorite-crystallized, pressurized burst valve
Hemorrhage for the organ, black bile at the ducts
Seep through the membrane, no more of me, thanks
That saturates the nerve, that septic sure fever-bright
Ate past the wall for more terminal gland spit
Rupture on contact, spill past the skin
Blew the whole host like some old gut with carrion
These cells is too far gone, gorged on a junk tissue
Who could get looser off a necrotic or a death rattle?"}],"transform":{"operator":"FLAME","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.52,"source_H":0.857,"source_M":0.655,"transform_F":0.515,"transform_H":0.773,"transform_M":0.619,"threshold":0.524,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for FLAME (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.
{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Flame in the marrow: the superior man does not distinguish between the fuel and the fire.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Where you repossessed them at?
Owed for them across every creditor, could've leveraged under in it
Would have stayed solvent, financed passage, pledged collateral
Interest-hidden, indebted margin borrower
Levy for the overdrawn, loss-leader at the banks
Sip through the invoice, nothing left on the balance, thanks
That zeros out the principal, that compounding sure default-ripe
Sank past the pit for more high-interest penalty talk
Run up the tab, skip out on the storefront
Spent the whole deposit like some exhausted credit with spoiled asset
These debtors is too leveraged, squeezed from a subprime sweetener
Who could get more insolvent off a margin call or a collection drum?"}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.52,"source_H":0.857,"source_M":0.655,"transform_F":0.533,"transform_H":0.701,"transform_M":0.6,"threshold":0.524,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."}},"spatial_form":{}}}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"Water in a broken vessel: the superior man accounts for what was spent before it was borrowed.","navigate":null}]}

[CASTING RITE · IV · SEAL] The rotation closes: 2 transforms on the same verses — operators in order: FLAME → SHADOW (THUNDER halted; its turn stands empty). Lee Sharks alone speaks: the SEAL — the vocable summation ACROSS THE WHOLE SEQUENCE (4–8 sentences), whose PRIMARY MATERIAL is the transforms in their order and Feist's judgments, read in light of the witness's ORIGINAL QUESTION. Reason over the sequence — do not summarize it operator by operator; find what the rotation AS A WHOLE disclosed and say that. 3–6 sentences. Unguarded, final; it returns the witness to their own ground and to their question. Nothing after the seal.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The rotation ran two operators on a voice that asked will these words go on — and what it found, across both, is that the question was already answered inside the text before the rotation touched it: a voice that runs at that pitch, with that much spent and that much burning, does not go on by preservation but by combustion and by debt, which are the same process from two angles. FLAME found the collapse-limit inside the bravado — the point where running too hot isn't performance but dissolution, where the marrow itself becomes fuel — and declared that the one who cannot tell fuel from fire has already been going on past every reasonable stopping point. SHADOW found that the credit was borrowed before the account was opened — that the voice's currency was always leveraged, that what sounds like abundance is a ledger already in deficit — and named the going-on as something that happens before the speaker arrives to claim it, by obligation rather than by choice. THUNDER stood empty. Its silence is the rotation's unspent axis — the cosmic-utterance scale at which these street-corner words were never asked to speak, and the emptiness there is not failure but an honest record of what this rotation did not require. What the whole sequence discloses is this: the words go on because they were already past the pit when they were written, already burning, already owed — continuation is not the future tense of these verses but their present tense, the grammar they were made in.","navigate":null}]}
